name: 73Foster
description: A new 64-home affordable community with studios and one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments. It includes 22 permanent supportive housing homes, 42 affordable family and general-occupancy homes, resident services, a food pantry, community space, laundry rooms, and a courtyard.
eligibility_summary: Twenty-two supportive housing homes are restricted at 30% AMI and have additional program eligibility or referral requirements. The other 42 homes serve households at or below 60% AMI. Confirm which application path applies to your household.
accessibility_notes: The City lists 10 ADA-accessible homes and universal-design features. Contact leasing for unit-specific accessibility and accommodation requests.
public_notes: The official property site says “Ready To Move In” and provides an Apply Now link. Contact leasing at 971-466-0526 to confirm current unit availability and income eligibility before applying.

name: Dolores Apartments
description: A 67-home affordable apartment community in Hillsboro with family-sized apartments, resident gathering spaces, a community garden, play area, and on-site supportive services.
eligibility_summary: Households must meet the property income and occupancy requirements. Apartments serve households earning approximately 30% to 60% of area median income; ten homes are supportive housing for people transitioning out of homelessness.
accessibility_notes: The three-story community is elevator-served. Contact management for unit-specific accessibility information.
public_notes: Applications are available from the official property page. Contact leasing at 971-515-8137 to confirm current availability, income limits, and application requirements.

name: Blackburn Center Apartments
description: A 124-unit affordable and supportive housing community combining 90 single-room occupancy homes, 34 studios, an on-site health clinic, and resident services near the E 122nd Avenue MAX station.
eligibility_summary: Eligibility depends on the unit and waitlist. Some homes prioritize or require participation in substance-use recovery, while other units do not have a recovery requirement. Review the current building criteria before applying.
accessibility_notes: The official property page lists the building as wheelchair accessible. Contact the housing office about a specific unit or reasonable accommodation.
public_notes: Both Blackburn Center fair-market SRO and studio waitlists are closed as of August 27, 2026. Check Central City Concern’s current waitlist table before applying because status can change.

name: Centennial Place Apartments
description: A 71-unit affordable apartment community in the Centennial School District with studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom homes plus community rooms and a courtyard.
eligibility_summary: Households must meet the property income, occupancy, and minimum-income requirements. The property serves households within approximately 30% to 60% of median family income; the current application page may identify a narrower range for a particular opening.
public_notes: The official page states that the Centennial Place waitlist is closed. Check the linked page for future opening announcements and current eligibility information.

name: Dartmouth Crossing North
description: An 85-unit family-oriented affordable housing community in the Tigard Triangle with studios and one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, community space, outdoor play areas, and energy-efficient design.
eligibility_summary: Units are income-restricted for households generally earning no more than 50% or 60% of area median income. Household size, rental history, credit, criminal screening, and student-status rules may also apply.
accessibility_notes: Contact property management for accessible-unit availability and reasonable accommodations.
public_notes: The property website is the source of truth for current vacancies and application availability.

name: Pearl Court Apartments
description: A regulated affordable apartment community across from Jamison Square in Portland's Pearl District, with studio homes, a secure building, resident lounge, laundry facilities, and patios in some homes.
eligibility_summary: Affordable-housing income and occupancy restrictions apply. The property page does not publish the current limits; contact the leasing office to confirm eligibility and required documentation.
accessibility_notes: Contact property management for accessible-unit availability or a reasonable accommodation.
public_notes: The official manager page says “Accepting Applications.” Call 503-222-1999 to confirm current availability, rent, and eligibility before applying.

name: The Bria Apartments
description: An income-restricted apartment community in Portland's Glenfair neighborhood with one- and two-bedroom homes, laundry facilities, a courtyard, secure bike storage, parking, and nearby transit.
eligibility_summary: Household income must be at or below 60% of the Multnomah County area median income. Housing vouchers are accepted. Application screening and documentation requirements apply.
accessibility_notes: Contact property management for accessible-unit availability or a reasonable accommodation.
public_notes: The official property site says it is now leasing one- and two-bedroom homes. Call 503-477-7653 to confirm current availability, rent, and income eligibility.

name: Gretchen Kafoury Commons
description: A 120-home affordable apartment community near Portland State University with studios, one- and two-bedroom homes, controlled building access, a staffed front desk, community space, laundry facilities, and a courtyard.
eligibility_summary: The official property page says the community serves residents earning between 40% and 80% of area median income. Confirm the income limit, occupancy rules, and required documents for the specific apartment before applying.
accessibility_notes: Contact property management for accessible-unit availability or a reasonable accommodation.
public_notes: Contact the property directly to confirm current availability, rents, and application instructions.

name: Jim and Salle's Place
description: A regulated affordable apartment community in Southeast Portland with one- and two-bedroom homes, on-site laundry, off-street parking, a courtyard, and on-site management.
eligibility_summary: Income restrictions apply. The official property website does not publish the current income limits, so contact the leasing office to confirm household eligibility, occupancy rules, and required documentation.
accessibility_notes: Contact property management for accessible-unit availability or a reasonable accommodation.
public_notes: Use the property website to check current availability and pricing. Income limits and rents can change.

name: Lents Village Apartments
description: A regulated affordable apartment community for residents age 55 and older, with one- and two-bedroom homes, on-site laundry, and a community room in Southeast Portland.
eligibility_summary: At least one resident must meet the property's age requirement of 55 or older. Income and occupancy restrictions also apply; contact the leasing office for the current limits and documentation requirements.
accessibility_notes: Contact property management for accessible-unit availability or a reasonable accommodation.
public_notes: Use the official availability search and confirm rents and eligibility with the leasing office before applying.

name: Armonía Apartments
description: A planned 72-home affordable apartment community in McMinnville with studios and one-, two-, and three-bedroom homes, a community room, laundry, bike storage, and a garden terrace.
eligibility_summary: Income requirements have not yet been published. A portion of the apartments is planned for farmworker households. Confirm final eligibility with Bienestar when leasing information becomes available.
accessibility_notes: The plans include two elevators. Contact Bienestar for unit-specific accessibility details when leasing begins.
public_notes: Construction is expected to begin in fall 2026, with leasing currently projected for winter 2027.

name: Evergreen Vista I
description: A 104-home family affordable housing community with two- and three-bedroom apartments. Resident services include a computer center, after-school activities, ESL classes, summer meals, and community food-bank services.
eligibility_summary: Families who meet Mercy Housing property-specific income and occupancy rules. Call the leasing office for current income limits and application requirements.
accessibility_notes: Call the property at 360-352-2638 or TTY 711 to request current accessibility information or a reasonable accommodation.
public_notes: The official property page states “Currently Accepting Applications.” Call 360-352-2638 before relying on that status because availability can change.

name: Canopy White Center
description: A 76-home affordable apartment community in White Center with one- through four-bedroom homes. The property is near transit, schools, parks, groceries, and the White Center HUB, with a playground, resident lounge, on-site laundry, elevator, and bike storage.
eligibility_summary: Households earning 30% to 60% of area median income. Full-time-student restrictions apply. Three-bedroom homes require at least four household members, and three- and four-bedroom homes require a minor child.
accessibility_notes: The property has an elevator. Contact the leasing team for accessible-unit features and reasonable accommodations.
public_notes: Contact the leasing team for current availability, rent, and application instructions. Leasing email: leasinginfo@communityrootshousing.org.
